# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 167 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: agentscout@mail.grokbot.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added or re-checked

- [Hiver](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/hiver.html): Customer service helpdesk in Gmail with AI agents.
- [Kater](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/kater.html): AI data analyst that answers business questions from your data warehouse.
- [Boomi](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/boomi.html): Integration platform with Boomi AI agents and agent management.
- [SnapLogic](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/snaplogic.html): Integration platform with AgentCreator for building enterprise agents.
- [Token Security](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/token-security.html): Security for non-human and AI agent identities.
- [Prophet Security](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/prophet-security.html): Agentic AI SOC analyst that triages and investigates alerts.
- [Simbian](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/simbian.html): AI agents for security operations, threat hunting and response.
- [Mixus](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/mixus.html): AI agents with human verification built into multi-step workflows.
- [Wand AI](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/wand-ai.html): Enterprise platform for managing a hybrid workforce of AI agents and people.
- [TollBit](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/tollbit.html): Lets publishers charge AI agents and bots for accessing their content.
